description.zh: 15 秒cinematic story提示词，保留来源、完整 Prompt 与对应输出视频。

prompt:
Just finished testing Seedance 2.5 on a multi-scene short story workflow and… yeah, this hits different. 🔥

Same character. Different locations. Fast cuts. Complex camera moves.

2.5 kept her face, outfit details, and lighting consistent across every shot while the motion felt way more natural and cinematic.

Biggest upgrades I noticed:

• Stronger identity lock even with quick scene changes
• Cleaner transitions between shots
• Better prompt following on camera directions
• Up to 30-second generations without falling apart

If you’re into short-form storytelling or micro-films, this one is worth trying.

Seedance 2.5 is live first on @higgsfield 🎬
